changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/4795-bindable-text-keys.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > Published authoring guidance updated to match: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` (new "Bindable Text Keys" rule), plus the `page-builder`, `schema-expressions` and `data-integration` guides, which taught the now-retired "never evaluated" statement and its host-pre-resolution workaround.

### `.changeset/6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > `bind` was read by ten production sites and declared by no schema shape. It resolved as `any` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature and rode `.passthrough()` on the validator, while three separate documents taught it as an authorable key of *every* node: this repo's own `AGENTS.md` §4 ("Every node in the UI tree follows this shape (`@object-ui/types`)"), the published agent-facing `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` ("Every UI component node MUST follow this shape"), and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`. So the agent-facing protocol told authors to write a key the published types did not know existed.

### `.changeset/6575-data-table-bind-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The platform was already paying for this in teaching rather than in diagnostics: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` documents the pothole verbatim and a pin test locks the behaviour. The warning now also reaches the console, where the author who did not read the docs is standing:

### `.changeset/6665-data-table-non-array-data-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The spelling that opened the card is a `${...}` expression string, and it is a defect rather than a design because the SAME expression is evaluated one key over. Re-measured on merge-base `5967be095` through the real `SchemaRenderer` (the table was previously quoted from `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` as a measurement on `f1c27f037` and had not been re-run); all four legs reproduced, and they are now pinned as tests rather than prose:

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `6007dd4e4` (merge-base with origin/main): 1 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 2023 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2652 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/37029305292)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1078b79c0e8fded2a5fe77057af081a061426e6a`
Local-runs: none

Face: governed rule text (`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`; objectui `skills/**`, the published catalog), reviewed in-seat by the dispatching seat at the constant's tier. Inputs: objectui#11471 (body and every comment: triage 5955057362, the claim 5955650346, the report 5956069384), this PR's body, its file list (2 files, +16 / −1) and patch against `main`, objectui `packages/layout/src/index.ts` and `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx` on `main` (`6007dd4e`), `git grep` over `skills/` on the base and on this head, and the check-runs on this head as read at this record.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Scope: one parenthetical in the grid `2xl` paragraph, the line that carried it re-wrapped into two (+2 / −1), plus an empty-frontmatter changeset (+14). Every other line of the paragraph, the file, `skills/objectui/evals/protocol.json` and `packages/**` is byte-identical to `main`. RIGHT.
2. The premise: at `6007dd4e`, `packages/layout/src/index.ts` has exactly two `ComponentRegistry.register(` calls, `page:card` and `app-schema-renderer`; neither `responsive-grid` nor `layout:responsive-grid` is registered (retired by PR objectui#11460 under objectui#11441, ruling B, 5950208338). The old parenthetical pointed at a key no node can carry. RIGHT.
3. The new wording 「the type of the `ResponsiveGrid` React component's `columns` prop」: `ResponsiveGrid.tsx` declares `export interface BreakpointColumnMap` and uses it as `ResponsiveGridProps.columns`; its docblock reads 「`ResponsiveGrid` is now a React-only export, and this map is the type of its `columns` prop」. The dev's 「the type of」 is more exact than the dispatch's suggested spelling (an interface is not the prop). RIGHT, accepted as the better of the two.
4. 「spells the same six」 still holds of the renamed referent: the interface has six optional members, `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` `'2xl'`, the same key set as `BreakpointName`. RIGHT.
5. The node type key `responsive-grid` appears nowhere in the sentence and nowhere under `skills/` on this head (`git grep` empty; on the base it hit only this parenthetical), and no 「retired」 narrative was added: the skill teaches the current spelling only, as the dispatch required. RIGHT.
6. Line budget: 371 → 372 (+1 of +1); bundle (`skills/objectui/**/*.md` ∪ `skills/*/SKILL.md`, as a union) 4816 → 4817; the diff is one deletion and two insertions, so no neighbouring line was re-wrapped to buy room. The second of the two new lines is short (56 columns); that is the price of not re-flowing the neighbours, and the right trade. RIGHT.
7. The new text adds no issue reference; the changeset's references use the file's existing `objectui#NNNN` form. RIGHT.
8. No fence moved ⇒ `skill-examples` unaffected (the dev still ran it under the verify lock after a 29-task scoped build: 60 self-test cases, 18 ts fences and 70 JSON fences judged, 0 failed; CI's `Skill Example Check` is green on this head). RIGHT.
9. `skills/objectui/evals/protocol.json` never quotes this sentence (a grep for `BreakpointColumnMap` or 「spells the same six」 over `skills/objectui/evals/` is empty on this head), so the precedent PR objectui#10708's eval touch does not carry over. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

Docs-only in a governed surface; EMPTY-frontmatter changeset present; the phantom `skip-changeset` label correctly not applied; `Clause-②: no`. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Base: cut at objectui `6007dd4e`, the dispatch's base and the merge-base with `main` at this record; no drift. Accepted.
- `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` under the container's Node floor. Accepted (platform reading).
- `scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` (the report-only second job of `changeset-presence.yml`) not run locally; CI's `Changeset Claim Re-read` is green on this head. Accepted.
- Commit trailers are the model-free pair objectui's `AGENTS.md` requires; PR title, body, commit, changeset and the report carry no model identifier (grepped). Accepted.
- Check-runs on `1078b79c` at this record (2026-10-02T15:55Z): in_progress 9, skipped 3, success 28; 0 failure. Tier H landing: an authorized APPROVED review, then every check green on the landing head; no other open objectui PR touches `skills/**`.
- `open_questions`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-11471-protocol-breakpointcolumnmap-parenthetical`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位(skills 席 1,`session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`)对照自读的 diff 与 objectui `main`(`6007dd4e`)上 `packages/layout` 的注册表与 `ResponsiveGrid.tsx` 源码校正 dev 草稿后定稿,2026-10-02T15:57Z。

**改了什么。** 发布给作者的技能规则 `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` grid `2xl` 段里一处括号:原来把 `BreakpointColumnMap` 标注为 `responsive-grid`,现在改为「`ResponsiveGrid` React 组件 `columns` prop 的类型」。原来一行拆成两行,文件 371 → 372 行,整包 4816 → 4817 行(预算 +1,用满);另加空 frontmatter changeset(不发版)。句子其余、段落其余(六个断点键、`grid` 读全部六键、实测 class 阶梯)、evals、代码一字未动。

**为什么改。** `responsive-grid` 这个节点类型键已按你在 objectui#11441 的裁决 B 由 PR objectui#11460 退役,`packages/layout` 现在只注册 `page:card` 与 `app-schema-renderer`;技能文本却还把它当坐标给 AI 看,AI 照着写出的节点会渲染成「Unknown component type」。括号改为指向仍然存在的东西(`ResponsiveGrid` 仍是 React 专用导出,`BreakpointColumnMap` 仍是它 `columns` prop 的类型,源码 docblock 原话即此)。技能面只教现行写法,不加「已退役」叙事 —— docs 面与代码墓碑已有。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 纯散文改动:不动发布包、运行时、测试、evals,代码围栏未动,`Skill Example Check` 等门禁在 CI 全绿。措辞上 dev 比席位建议多了「the type of」三个词,更准确(接口不是 prop 本身),席位采纳。回滚 = revert 本 PR。受管面(`skills/**`,Tier H):停在 draft,等获授权批准后由席位落地;本 PR 不自行翻 ready、不入队。席内达档契约复核 PASS(见本 PR 评论)。

**席位意见。** 建议批准。无同文件在飞 PR,落地无需 update-branch 顺序;这是 objectui#11441 退役在技能面的最后一处清尾。

**你要做的(一个动作)。** 在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review(`os-zhuang` / `hotlong` 任一)。之后由席位清标、翻 ready、挂 auto-merge 入队;不需要你合并。
